description: Create a Project node. Lands `status: active` unless you pass one (`paused` / `archived`) — every constructor of a type that carries a status takes it, and names what omitting it lands. CONTENT FIELDS ARE REQUIRED TO CREATE AND OPTIONAL TO REVISE: call it again with the same id and only what you are changing — omitted fields keep their stored value, so correcting one never means re-sending a 2 KB field you did not touch. Ask for this to start the top-level record of the thing being designed.

decomposition_levels.description:
THIS DESIGN'S DECOMPOSITION LADDER, ordered bottom-first: index 0 is
the finest grain. `hierarchy.rs` READS it on every level check and
nothing could write it, which made it the sharpest of the fourteen
holes (2026-09-07).

description.description: WHAT THIS IS, in prose — the only prose field a Project declares.

id.description: The project's id — `proj:<slug>` by convention. Calling again with an EXISTING id REVISES that node: what you pass overwrites, what you omit survives.

status.description:
`active` (the landing status) / `paused` / `archived`. One status
contract across every constructor of a type that carries one
(2026-09-19): omitted lands the type's landing status, stated here;
passed, it is stored as given. A project's status is a fact about the
work, not settled intent, so there is no `approver` on it.

name: add_project
